settings.title: Six Checks Before Every Claim Goes Out

settings.editor: To protect your revenue and prevent delays, every single claim is evaluated against six vital quality gates before clearinghouse dispatch.

settings.description_text: Demographic fields, subscriber IDs, relationship codes, and group numbers verified 100% error-free.
Active policy status, effective date windows, co-pays, and deductibles verified before batch generation.
Auth reference numbers logged and attached directly to billing lines for required clinical encounters.
CPT, ICD-10-CM, and HCPCS modifiers aligned accurately with clinical notes to justify medical necessity.
Evaluated through StelleCloud™ rules engine to catch NCCI bundle conflicts and modifier errors.
Carrier-specific billing guidelines applied so claims meet local clearinghouse requirements first pass.
